scope: Development comparison of exact representations on constructed profiles, with no system, real-workload or novelty qualification.
construction: Compare a source histogram with the histogram multiplied by the number of surviving sources; both probabilities and unknown support must agree.
controls: Shared ordered algebraic decision diagrams with a separate root per probability; ascending and descending source orders. Common coefficient gcd is normalized in recursive subproblems; constant distributions compile only their nonempty-support condition.
candidate: Unchanged polynomial identity implementation from source-prediction v1.
failurePolicy: Record an expected diagram resource-limit result and omit that order's remaining repetitions. Do not assign it infinite latency or count it as a speedup. Other failures abort. Compare finite medians only when both controls complete all repetitions.
promotion: No promotion from this cohort. A full source-aware state quotient and real behavioral workload are still required. Exact identity with a decision-diagram control establishes correctness, not originality.
